evidenceBoundary.exact: The selected method identities, field offset, code bytes, and direct calls prove that the checked unpatched object and position branches pass the serialized sound string, untrimmed, to one anonymous string-hash body. That body returns 0 for a null or empty string and otherwise hashes the full UTF-16 length with FNV-1 (offset basis 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x01000193), folding ASCII A-Z to lowercase; the object branch posts the result through AudioAdapter._PostEvent and the position branch through the UInt32 PostEventAtPositionWithMixingType overload. AudioHashGenerator.Compute(string) is no longer on either route.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: The native method prologues test iFix patches; the default-body route applies only when those methods are not replaced at runtime. An authored PlaySoundAction also must execute and select the checked branch.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: The iFix replacement branch, the AudioGlobalConfig pre-post branch in _DoPostEvent, other PlaySound routing branches, live action execution, bank loading, Wwise posting outcome, and audible media are not established here.
